attchmntText: TSF INVESTMENTS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: The Jo Engineering Limited released unaudited financial results for the quarter and year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 11, 2026. The company reported a net profit of Rs. 2040.76 lakhs for the quarter, compared to Rs. 1722.98 lakhs in the same period last year. For the year ended March 31, 2026, the net profit was Rs. 5514.20 lakhs. The earnings per share were Rs. 18.81 for the quarter and Rs. 32.83 for the year. Salona Cotspin Limited also released unaudited financial results for the quarter and year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 11, 2026. The detailed financial statements are available on the NSE website and the respective company websites.

attchmntText: TSF INVESTMENTS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding 'Investments in debt instruments issued by Group Companies '.
voiceSummary: TSF Investments Limited has approved investments up to 1,500 Crores in debt instruments issued by Group Companies. The Board of Directors approved this limit at a meeting held on 11th November 2026. These investments constitute material related party transactions under SEBI regulations. The Audit Committee has reviewed and approved the transactions. Shareholder approval is required for these material related party transactions. The company is seeking this approval through a postal ballot. The Board meeting commenced at 04:00 p.m. and concluded at 06:00 p.m. The disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30(4) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: TSF INVESTMENTS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  Dr R Raghuttama Rao as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 11, 2026.
voiceSummary: TSF Investments Limited appointed Dr R Raghuttama Rao, DIN 00146230, as an Additional Director and Non-Executive Independent Director. The appointment is effective from 11th November 2026 for a term of five consecutive years. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval through Postal Ballot. Dr Rao holds a PhD in Economics from IIT Madras, an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad, and a B.Tech from IIT Madras. He has over three decades of experience in Manufacturing, Financial Markets, Public Policy, and Management Consulting. He is currently the CEO of Gopalakrishnan - Deshpande Centre for Innovation & Entrepreneurship at IIT Madras. The Board Meeting took place on 11th November 2026, commencing at 04:00 P.M. and concluding at 06:00 P.M.

attchmntText: TSF INVESTMENTS LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: TSF Investments Limited submitted its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on 11th November 2026. Standalone profit after tax for the half year was 23,569.04 lakhs. Consolidated profit after tax and share of profit from associates for the half year was 27,808.47 lakhs. The company sold its entire holding in TVS Holdings Limited in October 2026 for Rs 822.51 crores. A net gain of Rs 731.22 crores was transferred to retained earnings. The company acquired 12,83,241 shares of Wheels India Limited for Rs 188.96 crores during the quarter. An NCLT order approved the merger of Forge 2000 P Ltd with Axles India Ltd with an appointed date of 1st April 2025. Limited review reports were issued by statutory auditors. Extracts of the results will be published in Financial Express and Makkal Kural on 12th November 2026.
